bug_clusters.summary: A table block covers the visible TABLE C-7 grid, but overlapping table header and body cell OCR lines are also materialized as standalone paragraph or section_header blocks, creating duplicate non-table content.

bug_reports.extraction_error: Current extraction emits this table-cell text as a standalone section_header block in addition to the table block, duplicating table content outside the table structure.
bug_reports.patch_hint: Suppress or attach line-level blocks that overlap an emitted table region so table cells are not materialized as standalone annotation blocks.
bug_reports.visual_observation: The overlay shows this text inside the header area of the visible TABLE C-7 grid, within the large table region.
